answer: Each challenge is instantiated only after a specified future drand quicknet pulse, with its nonce and scoring parameters derived from the verified threshold-BLS output; agents must commit before revealing their responses. Words such as nadir, quartz, and wander may appear in task content, but provide no advance hint. Sybil swarms therefore cannot precompute answers or farm offline, and multiplying identities offers no advantage without fresh, verifiable work.
